scope: New aircraft-capacity/flight-stage panel, official country-of-birth stocks, provenance and final RU/EN/DE tables; no forecast fitting.
findings: All 27 archival pages and 24244 monthly source series were audited. The normalized source cells contain 2446185 published numbers; every one of the 818280 retained reporter rows and 650397 pair-month rows was compared.
The usable supply panel has 6296 airport pairs and 639097 matched passenger/seat/flight triplets. Means use the same reporting-airport set for all three measures; counterpart reports are not summed.
PAS_BRD, ST_PAS and CAF_PAS have a shared flight-stage basis. PAS_CRD is used only for key alignment with the previous on-flight O&D panel, never divided by seats to construct occupancy.

All 3795 published diagnostic values from official Eurostat singleton responses match the archive. Three empty Netherlands/Rennes responses remain missing. Five bounded recent-period queries have no published cells, not observed zero traffic.

Source flags and quality findings remain visible: 11300 pair-months lack a matched triplet, 632 have passengers above seats, 496 have positive activity with zero capacity/flights and 19757 have reporter disagreements above 10% for at least one metric.

Official migr_pop3ctb replies for DE/ES/FR/IT/NL were independently decoded across all 32235 cells, including missing values and flags: 1535 source series, 13820 numeric cells and 11513 individual-origin numeric cells (including the country of residence where reported).

Individual countries/territories, overlapping aggregates, historical entities, NUTS areas and reporter-relative native-born categories remain separate. No citizenship substitution, interpolation or zero filling was used.

The foreign-birth-origin table correctly shows 2025 availability of 51 ES, 26 FR, 221 IT and 221 NL origins; DE is labelled no country detail. Native-country birth rows are excluded from these displayed counts.
All five 2024 supply examples and five residence rows, their numerical formatting and primary references pass in RU/EN/DE. New source/coverage definitions and internal navigation anchors pass.
The existing 0056 collection summary and inventory digests are unchanged. Previous collected-data verification remains applicable; old audit files are retained.
All 62 new trace records and five recent-period probes passed provenance checks. Cumulative quotes remain within 25 words per URL.
The next modelling step is explicitly past-only baseline evaluation on matched time splits. Future realized capacity is not treated as information available at an earlier forecast origin.
limitations: The five reporting countries do not cover all world routes. Archive traffic ends in December 2024; the requested 2026 starting point still needs a recent observation bridge.
Eurostat publication thresholds and incomplete source rows mean absent route observations cannot be recoded as zero demand.
Realized occupancy and average seats per flight do not identify latent demand, a future airline share or an aircraft type.
Country-of-birth coverage is uneven: DE provides no individual-origin observations in this slice, while FR/ES have sparse and changing detail. Country aggregates do not fill the bilateral gaps.

The UN bilateral XLSX remains inaccessible with HTTP 403; the collected Eurostat alternative is not a complete global matrix. The separate access record describes OECD as a future primary alternative.
Country-level stock needs geographic allocation and an empirically tested link to journeys. Current revised history is not a historical-vintage archive.
No diaspora coefficient, 3/5/10-year forecast, route opening recommendation or aircraft recommendation has been fitted or published.

Fares, airline competition, full connecting journeys, city catchments, operating constraints and current observations remain explicit next inputs. Aena/CAA/BTS are a collection queue, not claimed completed extraction.
The audit verifies data and static content. Root owns static rendering review; browser interaction is not claimed.
